name: Zwift

pricing.note: Annual is $199.99 (12 months for the price of 10; about $16.67/month is our arithmetic). One membership covers everything; hardware is not included.

trial: 14-day free trial on the monthly plan; annual has no trial but can be cancelled within 30 days for a refund
platformsNote: Not confirmed from the sources read this pass.
keyFeatures: Gamified progression with unlockable bikes and gear

name: TrainerRoad

pricing.note: Annual billed as $209.99 (listed as a $17.45/month equivalent).

trial: No free trial listed; 30-day money-back guarantee
keyFeatures: Sync with Garmin, Strava and Wahoo

name: MyWhoosh

pricing.note: Free to play per MyWhoosh's own FAQ. An optional subscription raises 'premium slot' credits for custom workouts and plans; its price was not shown on the pages read. Cosmetic in-app purchases exist.

keyFeatures: Workout builder and imports on the website
Optional subscription for more workout and plan slots

name: ROUVY

pricing.note: Single plan. Duo is EUR 29.99/month or EUR 249.99/year; Group EUR 59.99/month or EUR 499.99/year. A free tier allows 20 km a month. A USD price was not shown to our fetch.

keyFeatures: Real-world video routes from around the world

name: Wahoo SYSTM (Wahoo app Pro tier)

pricing.note: The SYSTM library sits in the Pro tier of the Wahoo app. Core is $4.99/month or $49.99/year without the SYSTM library; Base is free. A Wahoo support post records a 2025 price increase.

platformsNote: Not confirmed from the sources read this pass.
keyFeatures: Daily recommended workouts and training plans (Pro)
Strength, yoga and mental training content (Pro)
